summary: This article explains what natural resources are, why they are spread unevenly around the world, and why some countries have more of certain resources than others.
introduce: Read the title “Natural Resources and Where They Are Found” aloud and ask each student to write one question they hope the article will answer. Collect a few questions, then explain that today they will find the one big idea that ties all the details together.

keyTerms.def: to spread something out among different places or people
the study of rocks and how the Earth was formed
a layer of a natural substance, like a mineral, built up in the ground over time

challengeTerms.def: not enough of something; hard to find or in short supply
to take something out, especially from the ground
an amount of a resource that is available and ready to be used

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that it is fair that some countries have more natural resources than others? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Explain why natural resources are distributed unevenly around the world.
struggling: Read the first part of the article aloud together, review distribute, geology, and deposit, and let weak readers complete a main-idea-and-details web with a partner.
gifted: Ask strong readers to read a challenging version and write a short paragraph that uses scarce, extract, and reserve to state the main idea of the article in their own words.
